title: Reading Restaurant Reviews
description: Read short restaurant reviews and answer questions about them.

thumbnail.alt: A phone screen showing five gold stars and a food review

questions.prompt: Review: "The food was delicious, but the service was so slow! We waited 45 minutes for our drinks." — Did the person like the restaurant?

options.text: They liked the food, but not the service.
They hated the food and the service.
They thought the drinks were too expensive.

questions.explanation: They say the food was delicious (good), but the service was slow (bad).

questions.prompt: Review: "A bit pricey, but totally worth it for a special occasion. The steak was cooked to perfection." — What does "pricey" mean?
questions.explanation: "Pricey" is an informal word for expensive.

questions.prompt: Review: "I wouldn't recommend this place. The soup was cold and the waiter was rude." — Will this person go back?
questions.explanation: "I wouldn't recommend this place" means they had a bad experience.

questions.prompt: Review: "Great atmosphere and friendly staff. Make sure to book in advance because it gets very busy!" — What is the advice?

options.text: Reserve a table before you go.
Read a book while you wait.

questions.explanation: "Book in advance" means to make a reservation.

questions.prompt: Review: "The portions are huge! I had to ask for a doggy bag to take the rest home." — What is a "doggy bag"?
questions.explanation: A "doggy bag" (or a box) is used to take home food you didn't finish.

questions.prompt: Review: "It's a nice little spot, but it's cash only. There's an ATM next door, though." — How can you pay?
questions.explanation: "Cash only" means they do not accept credit cards.

questions.prompt: Review: "The vegetarian options were limited. All they had was a plain salad." — What is the problem?

options.text: There wasn't much food for vegetarians.

questions.explanation: "Limited" means there are very few choices.

questions.prompt: Review: "I've been coming here for years, and it never disappoints. The pasta is always fresh." — How does the reviewer feel?

options.text: They are a happy, loyal customer.
They are tired of the restaurant.

questions.explanation: "Never disappoints" means it is consistently good.
